sections.title: Crowley's Eights
sections.line: Crowley on the Eights and Hod, and the number Eight and Mercury: The Book of Thoth, pdf p179 and p234.

quotes.quote: The four Eights are attributed to Hod.
The number Eight, Hod, is very helpful in this card, because it represents Mercury in
The Eight of Wands is called Swiftness, as one might expect from its attribution to Mercury and Sagittarius.

sections.title: Jung's Hod
sections.line: Jung on Hod, beauty, and the left, feminine side: CW14 ¶635.

quotes.quote: Yesod unites the emanation of the right, masculine side (Nezach, life-force) with the left, feminine side (Hod, beauty)
